title: The Weft Schema
description: A unified graph schema for healthcare that fuses five domains normally modeled separately — clinical acts, people and organization, facility and space, device and sensing, and trust and AI-provenance — into one typed metagraph across hardware, software, and human (wetware) agents. 10 node families, 70 node types, 77 typed edges, 8 design principles, with every construct traced to a recognized standard (FHIR, W3C PROV, SOSA/SSN, Brick, SNOMED CT, ISA-95, GS1 UDI, OCEL). Published as a defensive publication establishing the five-domain fusion as prior art.
notes: Canonical home: https://weftgraph.org . Licensed under CC BY 4.0. The specification and its machine projection (weft.json) are the open layer; the executable pipeline, corpora, and policy packs that exercise the schema are not part of this publication.
